svg.title: Nguyen’s shrinking saddles: sphere–plane desingularization
svg.desc: A connected construction schematic and cutaway expose two caps, an inner disk, and one outer sheet joined by a Scherk saddle belt. Below is an unwrapped Scherk minimal surface. The global picture is not a solved shrinker.

g.text: One connected surface: spherical caps + inner disk + exterior, joined through a Scherk belt
Cutaway exposes the inner disk and lower cap
sin y = sinh x sinh z · two periods in y
Four wings of each Scherk period
z → ±∞: upper and lower spherical caps
x → +∞: exterior sheet, continuing to one end
Wrap m periods around the equator: genus m − 1.
Shown: m = 10, model genus 9; no small-m existence claim.
The completed shrinker has one conical end. The cone drawn here is chosen for illustration.
CONSTRUCTION SCHEMATIC · not a solved shrinker · all visible outer and cut edges are artificial
